evidence.detail: The class owns one java.awt.Image plus mutable x/y coordinates. a(String) loads a classpath image through Toolkit for file-backed resources or ImageIO for packaged resources, stores it and reports success.
a(int,int) updates the stored x/y position and a(Graphics) draws the stored image at exactly those coordinates through Graphics2D.drawImage when the live Launcher surface is available.
Exact-v308 reverse references come from launcher/loadout UI classes including rs/gui/b/e, rs/gui/b/f, rs/gui/b/g, rs/gui/b/b/b and rs/gui/b/c/b/c; no gameplay/world subsystem owns the type.

The constructor's auxiliary int does not acquire a stronger surviving semantic meaning, so the proposed name stops at the proven reusable positioned UI-image role rather than inventing an icon/sprite subtype.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the reusable UI image loader/holder/drawer at a mutable x/y position. No original source identifier is claimed.
